messages.subject: Setting up .Rprofile
parts:
Hello, 

Currently we have RStudio server installed on Ubuntu. We can login into RStudio without issue as we have setup proper user directory, etc.
Once login, we would want to automatically call Shiny runApp command.

Hence, we have created .Rprofile file within the same user directory and with proper read/write permissions and we have the following contents in the .Rprofile:

----------------------------------------------------------------
.First <- function() {
  library(shiny)
  runApp("myShinyApp", port=<a port number>)
}

cat("Hello")
----------------------------------------------------------------

What we observed is that it seemed the contents of .Rprofile was not being executed at all because we did not see the "Hello" message upon login into the RStudio. Any suggestion on what we could have done incorrectly ? 

Thanks in advance.
